profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hashgraph
profile.summary: Java software developer with experience in C++/Objective-C, distributed back-end services, desktop GUI toolkits, databases, web applications, text parsing/code translation, and systems/networks administration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Foundation team - Java/Web3

I'm building foundational frameworks that serialize, persist, and transmit data in the Hedera's distributed ledger.

On 7/24/2024, the company was rebranded as Hashgraph. It was formerly known as Swirlds Labs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on back-end services - Java/SQL/NoSQL/AWS/Distributed Systems

August 2015 - November 2023
Amazon Exports and Expansion - Export Eligibility team
* Built an event-driven, distributed Export Eligibility Platform that processes billions of products from Amazon catalog and determines their eligibility for international shipping.
* Built a reusable configuration-driven rules-based export eligibility contributor system that reduced the time-to-launch a new contributor 7 times - from a few weeks to just a few days, enabling the Business team to introduce new eligibility criteria promptly.
* Extended the rules-based contributor and built a generic configuration-driven message processor framework that reduced the effort to launch a new message processor to simply writing a single Java class and adding a few lines of configuration. This allows the platform to launch a new message processor 7 times faster - in a matter of just a few days, as opposed to spending a few weeks of effort on launching a brand-new service.
* Built several eligibility criteria contributors and worked on extending the platform capabilities to onboard new types of offers, support more granular eligibility computation, and ultimately expand the exportable selection of products on Amazon marketplace.
* Built internal web-applications to help Business and Compliance teams manage their eligibility criteria.

October 2014 - August 2015
Amazon Global - Amazon Global Store team
Amazon Global Store delivers goods to international customers in a localized store experience on regional marketplaces. I developed scalable, distributed back-end services that enabled Amazon to cross-list millions of offers from one marketplace to another, e.g. from amazon.com in the U.S. to amazon.cn in China, amazon.com.mx in Mexico, etc., in real time.

In 2023, I decided to shift gears and explore new opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Client Group. Worked on GUI toolkits JavaFX and Swing/AWT - Java/C++/Objective-C.

Major projects I worked on:
- Accessibility for JavaFX
- Swing/JavaFX Interoperability (JFXPanel, SwingNode)
- Windowing toolkit for JavaFX (Glass)
- AWT for Mac OS X
- Multi-Tasking Virtual Machine (MVM) technology support for AWT/Swing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Client Group. Worked on the AWT GUI toolkit - Java/C++.

Designed, developed, and delivered to JDK:
- Shaped and transparent windows support
- Enhanced AWT Security Warning
- Heavyweight/Lightweight Components Mixing

Has actively supported and encouraged code contributions from external developers to the OpenJDK project.

Links:
http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/articles/java/mixing-components-433992.html
http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/articles/javase/translucent-shaped-windows-139324.html
http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/articles/javase/appletwarning-135102.html

In 2010, Oracle acquired Sun.

positions.title: Software Developer, Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and deployed database applications:
- Emergency call-centers documents workflow and reporting system for the city department of the Emergency Control Ministry (EMERCOM) and subsidiary organizations - C++/SQL/MS SQLServer/Windows Server clusters
Link (in Russian): http://softmak.ru/company/projects/pr_edds.html
- Groupware/Tasks management Suite based on PHProjekt - PHP/HTML/SQL

Administered mixed Windows and Linux-based networks at the company and customers' sites, including Internet connectivity (Postfix, MS Exchange, Apache, Squid, iptables, Samba, Active Directory, MS SQL, MySQL, server clusters, etc.)

In 2006, I moved to Saint-Petersburg, Russia.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a multi-tiered database application for managing credit card payment records for an online billing service (charts, reporting, etc.) Built a cryptographic layer for secure data transfers over the Internet. - C++/BDE/Sockets/Networking.

In June 2001, the company was closed.
